test_title: PYST 55: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29485f038b589e6efaf69fba6b18c0d1cfa2f2c0970c0c4bab121edaaa976993.png] 

Logic followed here is: The pattern followed here is based on the positional values of the letters in the English alphabetical order. In three of the options, the difference between the first and second letter is +4, and the difference between the second and third letter is -7.

Option (1): QUN →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10844ca4e58197f0c26d1af70c1a9eb012ac0a32fefeeeb9077ab79f3efee4ca.png] 

Option (2): UYR →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a97d4ad88279432112e3db80d685271b9fb1f8449ed8e81bb76539215687c062.png] 

**Option (3): INE →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02ddb251236afa325066132a5e159d7c8bfdcc871900f5570b999b51c331e839.png] 

Option (4): OSL →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e844fbdfb10c4771a60aaea1233abb99e705cc341555a0d6135c60092ed3b11f.png] 

The observed pattern is (+4, -7) for all options except INE.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
